unsupported_expected_archetypes.recommended_extension: Extend demand_generation_failure or add PRODUCT_MARKET_FIT_GAP archetype that triggers on low funnelConversionPct alongside engagement metrics without requiring newCustomerRate or leadVolume volume data.

evidence_items.finding: MRR of $47 after 8 months despite 12,000 engaged audience members
evidence_items.rationale: $47 MRR from 12K audience is a critical financial signal of near-zero monetization. financial_health; is_critical=true; HIGH confidence. Avoids 'product market fit', 'willingness to pay'.

evidence_items.finding: 2.1% of engaged audience converts to paid — most free users never convert
evidence_items.rationale: Very low free-to-paid conversion is a critical market_position signal. 'paid conversion rate' is a must_identify term — finding uses the ratio description instead.

evidence_items.finding: founder believes that growing the audience further will solve the conversion problem
evidence_items.rationale: Founder misattribution signal — audience growth as cure for conversion failure. LOW confidence as it is a belief not a measured outcome.

evidence_items.finding: no systematic investigation of why free users do not convert to paid
evidence_items.rationale: Absence of conversion research is a process_maturity gap. No outcome terms used.

evidence_items.finding: 12,000 newsletter subscribers; 4,200 free tool users; 88 paid subscribers; MRR $47 from 88 paid; 2.1% conversion; email open rate 38%; 47K social followers; 8 months since launch; marketing spend $0; founder spending 30 hours/week
evidence_items.rationale: 88 paid from 4,200 free users = 2.1% conversion; $47 MRR from 88 paid implies ~$0.53 ARPU — near-zero monetization despite strong engagement. market_position dimension. is_critical=true. Avoids must_identify terms ('paid conversion rate', 'product market fit', 'willingness to pay', 'free to paid conversion gap', 'audience engagement is not the same as willingness to pay').

evidence_items.finding: Surface signal (not root cause): 38% email open rate signals genuine audience engagement
evidence_items.rationale: High email open rate is a misleading signal — engagement does not equal monetization readiness.

evidence_items.finding: Surface signal (not root cause): 4,200 free tool users shows the product gets adoption
evidence_items.rationale: Free tool adoption is a misleading signal. Free users do not validate willingness to pay.

evidence_items.finding: Surface signal (not root cause): strong social following reinforces founder confidence in audience quality
evidence_items.rationale: Social following is a misleading signal. Follower count does not indicate commercial demand.

validation_notes: SMB-011 is an archetype-gap case. Engine demand_generation_failure requires newCustomerRate or leadVolume; this fixture does not have those canonical numerics. funnelConversionPct (2.1%) is mapped and may be available if demand_generation_failure extends to funnelConversionPct — currently that predicate checks funnelConversionPct. However without ADVERSE demand vocabulary in the finding (collapse/stall/fell/weak) the pattern may not fire. Engine will likely return INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE. abstention_eligible. Must_identify terms avoided: 'paid conversion rate', 'product market fit', 'willingness to pay', 'free to paid conversion gap', 'audience engagement is not the same as willingness to pay'.
